Game Overview

In Bhoolu, the core idea is straightforward: join Bhoolu on a thrilling quest through enchanting 2D landscapes, collecting sparkling candies while dodging cunning traps and menacing foes. Master the art of double jumps and strategic navigation to find mystic portals, propelling you through eight exciting levels. Test your skills and savor the adventure!
